rounds: Old songs are better than anything in today's charts.
A cover version can be better than the original.
Vinyl is just a fashion: in five years nobody will buy it.
Musicians should be able to stop politicians from playing their songs.
A great song is ruined once it's used in an advert.
AI-made songs should be allowed in the charts.
Once a song is 50 years old, anyone should be able to use it for free.
